shape.description: Red barrel body three cells long, shaped like a little truck: a threaded white or grey knob sticks out of the back end, a white dome sits on top at the middle, a rounded window opens in each side under the dome, the front end is an open-top channel. White-tipped legs at each end stand on two stacks with one empty cell between.
shape.sizeBasis: Rough estimate: one cell about 52 mm and one slot about 36 mm, scaled from Joey's hand in IMG_0954 and IMG_0956; no ruler measurement. Footprint from maps 1-6, 2-8, 3-11; IMG_0942 shows it on floor plates, about 3 cells plus knob.

accepts: unknown: window seen on plan page 01, no plan use
top of a stack of the same height

physics.behaviour: Hand launcher. A marble waits in the chamber, a child works the back knob and the marble shoots out of the front along a track, up M-10 and into the T-Rex. No marble passes through it without the hand. First piece of the line in Levels 1 and 2 (nothing feeds it, so marbles go in by hand); mid-line in Level 3, where T-04 feeds the side window.

evidence.shows: Warnings: do not aim at eyes or face, do not discharge other objects: the set has a projectile launcher
Level 1: stands on L4 and N4 (both height 2), knob south; T-07 from front to M-10; no feed
Level 2: stands on N4 and N6 (both height 3), knob east; front into T-04, curving to M-10; no feed
Level 3: stands on J5 and L5 (both height 2), knob south; T-06 to M-10; T-04 arrives from the I7 side and enters the window under the dome
Real piece on plates: threaded knob, dome, window, open channel at front

evidence.source: vtechkids product text, via web search result only
evidence.shows: Dino-snack launcher; propel marbles into the jaws. Page could not be opened directly; treat as weak

assumptions: Port heights assume track level is one slot above the supports: M-10 base adds one slot on the same height stack, and the track between them is level in every placement.
Knob mechanism unknown: pull or push, spring assumed.
Hand loading in Levels 1 and 2 is assumed since nothing feeds it there; where the marble goes in is unconfirmed.
faces uses E=+x, W=-x, S=+y, N=-y, in the piece's own frame. Heights are slots above the floor when the piece stands on the floor or, where stated, above the top of its supports.
